title: Strip paragraph direction: a w:bidi Arabic paragraph ends at the right margin, an LTR paragraph runs from the left margin in reading order, a w:bidi paragraph holding only an LTR run sits at the right margin
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-10-29), pymupdf: Letter 1440 margins (text column 72 .. 540), header 720, docDefaults Calibri 11; w:bidi + cs Arial 12 w:rtl Arabic paragraph x 462.21 .. 540.00; LTR `abc 123 def` Calibri 12 x 72.00 .. 128.74; the same run inside a w:bidi paragraph without w:rtl x 483.26 .. 540.00 in reading order; an LTR paragraph opening with an Arabic run keeps it at 72.00 .. 101.94 and the Latin tail at 101.94 .. 167.84. gen emitted direction:rtl without isolating the paragraph and no explicit direction for LTR paragraphs

cases.note: w:bidi with an LTR-only run: the paragraph is still right-to-left, the run keeps reading order
no w:bidi: an Arabic first run does not turn the paragraph
